Sell digital products with AI

Gumroad MCP
for Claude

Connect your Gumroad store to Claude. Create product drafts, check sales, and track payouts from your chat.

Listed in Claude’s connector directory. You can also add it as a custom connector.

Add Gumroad to Claude

You’ll need a Gumroad account and MCP support in Claude.

An MCP server for selling digital products

What can you do with Claude?

Use Model Context Protocol (MCP) to connect your AI assistant to your store. Manage ebooks, templates, courses, and other digital products.

“Show my recent sales.”

See which products people bought and what they paid.

“Draft my next product.”

Ask for a product name, price, and description. Add the product files in Gumroad before publishing.

“Check my latest payouts.”

Check recent payout amounts and their status.

Set up Gumroad MCP

How do you connect Claude?

Add Gumroad from Claude’s connector directory. On Team and Enterprise plans, your organization’s settings control which connectors you can add.

  1. 1. Add the connector

    Open Gumroad in Claude’s connector directory and connect it. Or open Settings > Connectors in Claude, choose Add custom connector, and enter the URL below. If you cannot add connectors, ask your organization administrator.

    Gumroad in Claude’s connector directory

    MCP server URL

    http://app.test.gumroad.com:31337/claude/v1/mcp

  2. 2. Connect your Gumroad account

    Sign in to Gumroad when prompted. Review the requested permissions before you authorize access.

  3. 3. Start a conversation

    Select the connector in your chat. Try asking, “Show my Gumroad products.”

What access do you give Claude?

What data can it read?

The connector can access your products, sales, buyer emails, and payouts according to the permissions you grant.

Can it publish products?

New products start as unpublished drafts. With product access, the connector can publish or unpublish them. Review these actions in your MCP client.

How do customers buy?

Share your product’s Gumroad link. Customers pay through Gumroad checkout. The MCP server does not take payments in your chat.

How do I revoke access?

Revoke the connection any time under Authorized Applications in your Gumroad settings. Disconnecting the connector in your chat app does not revoke its access token, so revoke it here to end the connection.
